description: Community Assessment Reporting Tool (CART) is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by HUD, U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development. This map provides a snapshot of HUD investments across a community, by city, state, county, metropolitan area, or congressional district. Users can explore HUD investments within their community and see property- and grant-level detail for a variety of geographies. CART includes information on many of HUD’s major programs, including:. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page.  Assets: Energy and Utilities, People, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
